BTC and ETH merit only modest conviction reductions; SOL and LTC are weaker still. The identical long verdicts for XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are highly fragile because they have identical composite and conviction values with zero volatility, expected shortfall, liquidity, and institutional-factor inputs, suggesting insufficient signal detail rather than genuine differentiated conviction.
